title: Items waiting on a person's placement
description: What GET /api/v1/review answers and `ingestion review list --json` prints: each item that waits on a person, the longest waiting first: one that the side gate sent to review, one that holds no usable parse, and one that the quality gate sent to review before any side decision. POST /api/v1/review/{key}/place takes one of the destinations the set in force declares, and answers schemas/review-placement.schema.json. A caller holding ingestion.review.read reads each item's title, URL, quality answer and sightings' fields here, without ingestion.items.read. Where the zone is outside, each is a stranger's text or a model's reading of it.

reason.description: Why the item waits: its sightings' tags disagree, the guess fell below the floor, no tag or rule placed it and the quality gate gave no answer, because its run failed, its scan could not read the set in force, or it waited in review from before the quality gate ran, the side gate could not read the set in force or the item's sightings, it has no usable parse, or the quality gate sent it to review.

guess.description: The quality gate's side guess, where it gave one.

quality_answer.description: The quality gate's newest done answer, in the shape prompts/quality/answer.schema.json holds. Null where the gate gave none. Its idea and themes are a model's reading of the item, so they take the item's zone.

sightings.description: Each connector's arrival of the item: the tags the side gate read, and the source's fields, such as a Reddit save's subreddit, which a routing rule matches.

destinations.description: Each destination the set in force declares, in its order, which a placement takes. side is the side an item placed there takes, and null where the destination drops what it takes. Empty where the set declares none, and null where the set in force could not be read, so the queue still answers.
